title: Descobrir v1 ArtifactManifest
description: Versioned inventory of Native Artifacts for one Descobrir load. Native Artifacts are untrusted. Default v1 preservation is in-place: this manifest stores relative path, content hash, and metadata; raw artifact bytes remain in the target context and are NOT copied into harness output or baseline. Represents the current artifact set for this load — not a history of multiple engine runs. Paths are relative to the logical repository; absolute machine paths are forbidden. Engine name and profile are generic strings narrowed by Project Profiles. Manifest id is content-addressed from namespace + logical_repo + source_revision + engine/profile + sorted artifact content_sha256 values (never from acquisition_mode, timestamps, or run ids).

id.description: Deterministic content-addressed manifest ID. Producers MUST derive it solely from: namespace, logical_repo, source_revision, engine.name, engine.profile, and the sorted list of artifact content_sha256 values (lexicographic ascending). Excluded from the derivation: acquisition_mode, observed_at, producer_run_id, freshness timestamps, adapter name, media_type, byte_length, and any wall-clock metadata. Same structural inputs MUST yield the same id.

namespace.description: Knowledge Namespace of the owning project. IDs and persistence are scoped to this namespace.

logical_repo.description: Logical repository identity independent of machine path. Valid as the <logical> segment in repo:// URIs after normalization (see repo-reference.md). Generic string — not a closed enum.

source_revision.description: Pinned logical VCS revision that anchors the load. Format is VCS-agnostic.

name.description: Discovery Engine name as a generic non-empty string. Not a closed enum in this contract.

profile.description: Engine profile as a generic non-empty string.

version.description: Artifact Adapter version that will read these artifacts.

name.description: Optional adapter implementation name. Generic string when present.

adapter.description: Adapter identity for the load. version is required; name is optional metadata.

acquisition_mode.description: How Native Artifacts were obtained for this load. reused: existing artifacts whose declared revision matches source_revision were reused without a new engine run. fresh: Discovery Engine was invoked to produce artifacts for this load. Describes this load only — not a multi-run history. Excluded from manifest id derivation.

artifacts.description: Complete inventory of preserved native/index/projection artifacts for this load (current set only). Empty only when the engine produced nothing (still a valid incomplete load signal when paired with freshness). Raw bytes are NOT embedded; only path/hash/metadata.

freshness.description: Observational freshness metadata. Timestamps here are metadata only and MUST NOT participate in manifest id or canonical_graph_hash inputs.

logicalRepo.description: Single-token logical repository identity accepted by repo://. No slash, @, or whitespace.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of artifact bytes.

relativePath.description: Repository-relative path using forward slashes. One or more segments; each segment non-empty, not '.' or '..', no backslash, whitespace, NUL, or reserved characters % ? # @. No percent-encoding. No absolute paths.

artifactRole.description: native: producer-owned primary output preserved intact in-place. index: machine-oriented index derived by the engine. projection: human-oriented disposable view (never factual input).

path.description: Relative path of the artifact as inventoried for the logical repository. Must match ArtifactReference.artifact_path when referenced.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of the artifact in the target context (in-place). Not a copy into harness output.

declared_revision.description: Revision the producer declared when emitting the artifact. May equal source_revision or a producer-specific production revision string.

media_type.description: Optional IANA media type or producer content-type hint.

byte_length.description: Optional byte length of the artifact content in the target context.

status.description: complete: artifact fully captured in inventory. incompleto: partial capture after engine failure or partial run (FLOW phase 2).

source_revision.description: Echo of the load anchor revision for freshness checks. v1 records source_revision; incremental updater is out of scope.

observed_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp of when artifacts were observed. Metadata only; excluded from manifest id and canonical_graph_hash.

producer_run_id.description: Optional producer run correlation id. Metadata only; excluded from manifest id and canonical_graph_hash.

freshnessMetadata.description: Freshness and observational metadata. Timestamps and run ids are not canonical identity.
